text.p: Holders of debt issued by Industria Automotriz S.A. de C.V. (Iasasa) have agreed to form a committee to restructure payments due, the company said in a report to the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV) on Tuesday.
Representatives from the Arka and Vector brokerage houses, Mexico's National Development Bank (Nafin) and Iasasa would sit on the committee, the company said.
"The aim of the ... committee will be to review the issuer's restructuring proposal and to propose an alternative financing plan," the company added.
Iasasa issued 75 million pesos of seven-year bonds with a fiduciary guarantee on September 17, 1992, and which were to pay interest quarterly.

Debt holders agreed to modify the conditions of issue. They agreed that interest payments would be deferred for three months and three years for principal payments. Amortisations originally due on December 17, 1996, and March 17, 1997, will thus be postponed until June 17, 1997.
Iasasa agreed not to contract any additional debt.
